title: MEIKO — Who We Are〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Okay, the plates and spoons are all set.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Everything's ready.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hiya!
Oh, there really is curry here!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We decided to come over after Miku and Luka said that there's a curry party going on, but... Where'd you guys get this?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Honami brought it over a second ago.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Honami did?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes. She apparently made some as a present for Ichika and Saki to have during their songwriting camp...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: And she was kind enough to make enough for us.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wow! Hona's so sweet!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Yes, she really is.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: This curry looks good...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: This is Honami we're talking about, so I'm sure she put quite a lot of effort into it.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah, definitely!
There's no way it's not gonna be amazing♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Anyway, now that we're all here, let's start digging in.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
The rice is in that plastic container.
Please use this ladle for the curry...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Okay!
I call first dibs☆

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wait, Rin!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Heehee. I'm gonna grab myself tons of shrimp!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hey, slow down! Don't take so much!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Is there going to be any left for the rest of us...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Stop right there.
Put the ladle down, Rin!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
At the rate you were going, there really wasn't going to be anything left for the rest of us.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Sorry...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Honestly...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: To be fair, I don't blame Rin for trying. A free-for-all does sort of mean some getting more than others.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, that's true...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Alright, let's do this.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'll make a plate for each of you.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Wait, MEIKO, are you sure?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, since we'll get more even servings if one person handles that task.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Sure, but it's like we're having a school lunch now...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah, you're right!
That sounds like fun, so I'm in!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Okay.
Then, form a line and I'll start serving up this curry!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, MEIKO!
Can I have a little more shrimp?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You already have plenty. The rest is for the others.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Oh, sorry...
Can I have a little more rice, MEIKO? I'm actually pretty hungry...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: More rice...? That should be fine since it seemed like we were going to have extra anyway. So, here's a nice, big serving.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. This really feels like a school lunch.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, it does. While we're at it, why don't we put our desks together?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, nice idea!
Gimme a sec to bring my desk over that way!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Actually, this is kind of nice.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But a little embarrassing at the same time. I'm not sure how I feel about us facing each other like this while we eat.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe. That's understandable.
But it might be fun to do something like this every once in a while.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah, totally☆
Anyway, MEIKO, you gotta do the thing.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: The thing...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hehe. Oh, is that what you mean?
Got it.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Alright, everyone, are you all ready?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Let's eat.

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line:
Let's eat!
Let's eaaat!
